The Herbie Mann String Album is an album by American jazz flautist Herbie Mann recorded for the Atlantic label and released in 1967.[1]

Reception

[edit]
Professional ratings
Review scores
SourceRating
AllMusic[2]

AllMusic awarded the album 3 stars.[2]
